Form.title: Welcome to The Project Hub
Form.mentor_label: I am available as a mentor

mission_text: A platform built to connect Sudanese talent in Egypt and the diaspora. Build your professional portfolio, connect with complementary skills locally, and attract global mentorship and sponsorship.
slogan: Empowering Sudan's Next Generation of Makers.
hero_subtitle: A platform for Sudanese makers to be seen, build teams, and access mentorship. Create a portfolio that organizes your projects, skills, and resume, then connect with people and opportunities nearby.
mission_body: Empower Sudan's next generation of makers by providing a platform for collaboration, professional development, and opportunity matching.
goal_body: Connect unseen Sudanese talent in the diaspora with peers, mentors, and employers, starting with a focused pilot program.
pilot_body: Starting in Egypt with a 100-person cohort to build trust, measure impact, and refine matching.
steps_tagline: Built for makers, mentors, and sponsors.
step1_desc: Add your story, skills, location, and projects in Arabic or English. Upload a resume or link to past work.
step2_desc: Your projects, skills, and resume are arranged into a clean, shareable profile people can scan quickly.
step3_desc: Find nearby teammates and diaspora mentors. Get recommendations for projects based on your passion and major.
community_body: We highlight projects, help teams form, and make local talent discoverable. The goal is to build confidence, visibility, and real collaboration.
sponsor_body: Companies, donors, and public partners can offer internships, talks, resume reviews, and interview preparation based on local needs.
sponsor_copy: Egypt-first, with pathways to connect Sudanese talent globally once the pilot shows results.
matchmaking_body: Discover makers, mentors, and projects near you. Start with the pilot cohort and build real collaborations.
feature1_desc: Automatically arrange your projects, skills, and resume data into a professional, scannable online profile.
feature2_desc: Connect with makers and professionals in your city (starting with Egypt) who have complementary skills for your projects.
feature3_desc: Gain visibility to sponsors and mentors offering internships, resume reviews, and career insights.

home.hero_proofline: For the ambitious leaders of tomorrow
home.hero_title: Sudan's makers — visible, connected, and ready.
home.hero_body: Build a profile that shows your skills, projects, and story — in Arabic or English. Connect with makers in Egypt, mentors in the diaspora, and companies looking for talent like yours.
home.hero_body_line_1: Build a profile in Arabic or English that shows your skills, projects, and what you're working toward.
home.hero_body_line_2: Connect with makers in your city, mentors in the diaspora, and companies looking for talent like yours.
home.mockup_title: Profiles that make talent easy to find
home.mockup_query_title: One place for your projects, skills, and story
home.mockup_query_body: Everything you've built, organized into a profile anyone can understand at a glance.
home.mockup_context_body: Sudanese talent is everywhere — in Egypt, the diaspora, and beyond. The Project Hub makes it easier to find each other and build together.
home.audience_founders_body: Build a portfolio that shows what you can do. Share it with collaborators, mentors, and employers — no CV needed.
home.audience_recruiters_body: Find and support promising Sudanese talent in Egypt. See their projects, skills, and what they're working toward.
home.audience_investors_body: A stronger network means more teams forming, more mentors connecting, and more talent becoming visible — locally and globally.
home.steps_title: Three steps from profile to opportunity
home.steps_intro: Tell your story once. Your profile does the rest — connecting you with the right people, projects, and mentors.
home.step1_body: Add your skills, city, and projects in Arabic or English. Your profile is your first impression.
home.step2_body: Your projects and skills come together into a clean, shareable profile — ready to show anyone.
home.step3_title: Connect with people who get it
home.step3_body: Find makers nearby, get matched with mentors, and explore projects that need your skills.
home.process_caption: Your profile connects you to makers, mentors, and projects that match your skills and where you want to go.
home.flow_profile_body: Showcase your skills, projects, and what you want to create.
home.flow_match_body: Connect with teams and opportunities in your city and region.
home.flow_mentorship_body: Get guidance from experienced people and build real experience.
home.flow_hub_body: Connects your profile to the people and opportunities that matter.
home.flow_you_body: More visibility, warmer introductions, and real experience — faster.
home.features_intro: Every part of the platform is designed to help you be seen, find the right people, and build real experience.
home.feature_search_body: Show your projects, skills, and story in a format anyone can scan and trust — no noise.
home.feature_graph_body: Find makers, mentors, and collaborators near you. The pilot starts in Egypt, with Cairo and Alexandria first.
home.feature_intro_body: Get matched with collaborators and mentors based on your skills, location, and what you're working on.
home.feature_context_body: Get in front of companies and mentors who are actively looking for Sudanese talent to support.
home.trust_body: This is not social media. There are no algorithmic feeds, no follower counts, and no ads. It is a focused platform for visibility, collaboration, and real opportunity.
home.privacy_body: Your profile helps you get discovered — it is never sold, shared without consent, or used to target you with ads.
home.signal_body: No feeds to scroll, no metrics to chase. The platform stays purposeful so you can focus on building, connecting, and growing.
home.mentorship_title: Learn from people who've been where you want to go.
home.mentorship_body: Connect with Sudanese professionals in the diaspora who volunteer their time for resume reviews, career conversations, and warm introductions. No cold emails — just real guidance.
home.mentor_benefit_1_body: Get real feedback on your CV from professionals who hire in your field.
home.mentor_benefit_2_body: Talk through your path with someone who has navigated it.
home.mentor_benefit_3_body: Get connected to the right people — not cold outreach.
home.mentor_benefit_4_body: Mentors span Egypt, the Gulf, Europe, and North America.
home.final_body: Join the 100-maker pilot cohort in Egypt. Create your profile in Arabic or English, explore the network, and start building real connections.
home.problem_title: Too many talented people are ready to build — but they have no clear place to start.
home.problem_body: Great skills and real ambition aren't enough when you don't have visibility, a warm network, or a path into the right community.
home.problem_bubble_1: I don't have any experience yet.
home.problem_bubble_2: I have experience, but I don't know where to apply it.
home.problem_bubble_3: I need mentorship and real opportunities, but I can't find them.
home.solution_title: The Project Hub helps you build experience, find the right people, and grow through real collaboration and mentorship.
home.solution_body: Instead of figuring it out alone, you get a path — from building your profile, to finding your community, to real momentum.
